findings.description: Post-refresh freshness reuses process-wide input hashes cached by the initial status call. Changes to existing watched files during generation can therefore remain invisible, allowing a stale graph to be presented as refreshed. This violates FR-373 and the documentation's freshness guarantee.
findings.recommendation: Recompute input hashes after generation and compare them with the recorded build inputs. Cover edits during refresh without mocking status.

findings.description: The foreground refresh used by this feature never acquires a lock. Its debounce timestamp only prevents another refresh for 60 seconds, while generation can run for 30 minutes. A second request after that window can start an overlapping generator and overwrite shared output, cache, log or stamp files. The lock check and debounce write are also non-atomic.
findings.recommendation: Acquire an atomic lock shared by foreground and background refreshes, retain it throughout generation, and release it reliably. Add actual concurrency coverage for AC-370-4.

findings.description: GraphOnMiss mocks both status and refresh, so it cannot establish real freshness or concurrency behavior. The declared unittest command also skips the module-level pytest tests, including existing lock and debounce checks. The supplied scope contains no executed verification results; none were executed during this review.
findings.recommendation: Declare a runner that collects the pytest tests and preserve execution evidence for the required checks, including real refresh integration, concurrency and changes during generation.
